notes: Azure lists version 2026-11-02 as Global Standard Preview with native text-to-image generation and image editing. The Foundry catalog publishes a 32000-token context and 4096 output-token limit; maxInputTokens is not independently published.

The mai-image route uses /mai/v1/images/generations on the Foundry services endpoint, and mai-image-edits uses /mai/v1/images/edits with multipart reference images. Set targetModel to the actual deployment name; HTTP media must be enabled.
Generation expands an explicit WIDTHxHEIGHT size into width and height. Microsoft documents transparent backgrounds for this model; generation size expansion does not apply to edits.

Microsoft's model card lists a maximum of 4194304 output pixels, equivalent to 2048x2048; either dimension can exceed 2048 within that area. The edits API accepts up to five JPEG or PNG reference images.
Microsoft's MAI API guide documents auto_aspect_ratio and web_grounding for the 2.6 models, not this 2.7 deployment. The proxy does not locally reject native parameters on that basis.

Azure Retail Prices API MAI Models Global consumption meters checked 2026-11-18 separately publish text input, image input and image output per 1M tokens, effective 2026-11-01. Cache and text-output prices are not published in these meters.
Scalar text pricing and automatic Azure media price fallback are disabled. The media rates are references unless an administrator supplies a media pricing override and sufficient usage is reported.
